properties.NAME: Illinois Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The U.S. created Illinois Territory from Indiana Terr.; included all of present Illinois (except small areas along the Wabash R.), and parts of present Wisconsin, Michigan, and Minnesota. Map depicts non-county area of Illinois Terr. in present Illinois.
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 16:6-8; U.S. Stat. vol. 2, ch. 13 [1809]/ pp. 514-516.
